title: Treatises
author: cyprian
attributionNote: The attribution is recorded as the edition and the scholarly consensus give it; where the attribution is disputed, the work says so.
description: Cyprian's pastoral treatises from Carthage: on the unity of the church, on the lapsed who sought readmission after persecution, on almsgiving, on mortality, and on the Lord's Prayer.
historicalContext: Written while bishop of Carthage during the Decian persecution and the disputes that followed over readmitting the lapsed.
availabilityNote: Streamed from the Christian Classics Ethereal Library at read time. Wallis's translation from the Ante-Nicene Fathers, served by the CCEL.
